   "source": [
    "# This cell is removed with the tag: \"remove-input\"\n",
    "# As such, it will not be shown in documentation\n",
    "\n",
    "import warnings\n",
    "warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "66f9f8df",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "(Tutorial_Wrap_to_pbc)=\n",
    "# Wrap to PBC\n",
    "\n",
    "*Wrapping atomic coordinates into the primary periodic boundary condition unit cell.*\n",
    "\n",
    "The function {func}`molsysmt.pbc.wrap_to_pbc` maps atomic coordinates back into the primary space-filling periodic unit cell.\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{versionadded} 1.0.0\n",
    ":::\n",
    "\n",
    ":::{admonition} API documentation\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "Follow this link for a detailed description of the input arguments, raised errors, and returned objects of this function: {func}`molsysmt.pbc.wrap_to_pbc`.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "4c7d5642",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Basic usage\n",
    "\n",
    "Let's wrap a continuous trajectory into the primary periodic box:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 2,
   "id": "97369339",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:50.621449Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:50.621005Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:51.675214Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:51.674109Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "import molsysmt as msm\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 3,
   "id": "726fdac4",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:51.678880Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:51.678465Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:56.843027Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:56.841862Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "molsys = msm.convert(msm.systems['two LJ particles']['traj_two_lj_particles.trjpk'], to_form='molsysmt.StructuresDict')\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "871d2c6d",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    ":::{note} Demo Systems Catalog\n",
    ":class: dropdown\n",
    "\n",
    "This tutorial uses demonstration datasets provided by MolSysMT. To explore the full catalog of bundled systems, forms, and file paths, visit the {ref}`Demo Systems <user-foundations-entrance-demo-systems>` guide.\n",
    ":::\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "e5f7bbef",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We inspect the continuous particle coordinate trajectory before wrapping:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 4,
   "id": "f46d7d84",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:56.846107Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:56.845604Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:57.345807Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:57.344986Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 700x350 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.5))\n",
    "time = molsys['time']\n",
    "ax.plot(time, molsys['coordinates'][:, 0, 0], label='Particle 0 (X)', color='navy')\n",
    "ax.plot(time, molsys['coordinates'][:, 1, 0], label='Particle 1 (X)', color='firebrick')\n",
    "ax.set_title('Continuous Coordinates Before Wrapping')\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('Time (ps)')\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel('Coordinate (nm)')\n",
    "ax.legend()\n",
    "ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "365308fe",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We fold all atomic coordinates into the primary periodic unit cell with {func}`molsysmt.pbc.wrap_to_pbc`:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 5,
   "id": "695ed63a",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:57.348708Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:57.348435Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:58.038530Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:58.037074Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "molsys_wrapped = msm.pbc.wrap_to_pbc(molsys)\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "9cd486c5",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Plotting the wrapped coordinates confirms that all coordinates now evolve strictly within the periodic cell boundaries:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 6,
   "id": "9aa725c4",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:58.042567Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:58.041783Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:58.871012Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:58.869692Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 700x350 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 3.5))\n",
    "ax.plot(time, molsys_wrapped['coordinates'][:, 0, 0], label='Particle 0 (X)', color='navy')\n",
    "ax.plot(time, molsys_wrapped['coordinates'][:, 1, 0], label='Particle 1 (X)', color='firebrick')\n",
    "ax.set_title('Wrapped Coordinates Inside Primary Periodic Cell')\n",
    "ax.set_xlabel('Time (ps)')\n",
    "ax.set_ylabel('Coordinate (nm)')\n",
    "ax.legend()\n",
    "ax.grid(True, linestyle='--', alpha=0.5)\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "plt.show()\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "6a26b250",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We verify that inter-particle distances evaluated under periodic boundary conditions remain invariant under wrapping:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 7,
   "id": "58b40a64",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:58.874766Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:58.874295Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:37:59.904128Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:37:59.896062Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Periodic distances invariant under wrapping: True\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "dist_orig = msm.structure.get_distances(molsys, selection=0, selection_2=1, pbc=True)\n",
    "dist_wrap = msm.structure.get_distances(molsys_wrapped, selection=0, selection_2=1, pbc=True)\n",
    "print('Periodic distances invariant under wrapping:', np.allclose(dist_orig, dist_wrap))\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1ea686ab",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "## Preserving covalent bonds during macromolecular wrapping\n",
    "\n",
    "When wrapping macromolecular structures containing bonded atoms (such as solvated proteins or peptides), setting `compact='component'` ensures connected covalent blocks are reconstructed and translated together:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 8,
   "id": "082690fd",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:37:59.910102Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:37:59.909698Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:38:02.982375Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:38:02.980951Z"
    }
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "molsys_pep = msm.convert(msm.systems['Met-enkephalin']['met_enkephalin.h5msm'])\n",
    "molsys_solv = msm.build.solvate(molsys_pep, box_shape='cubic', clearance='14.0 angstroms', engine='PDBFixer')\n",
    "molsys_pep_wrapped = msm.pbc.wrap_to_pbc(molsys_solv, compact='component')\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "7cb21d99",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "We visualize the wrapped solvated macromolecular system in 3D:\n"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 9,
   "id": "d3dbaf35",
   "metadata": {
    "execution": {
     "iopub.execute_input": "2026-08-19T12:38:02.986074Z",
     "iopub.status.busy": "2026-08-19T12:38:02.985801Z",
     "iopub.status.idle": "2026-08-19T12:38:02.989706Z",
     "shell.execute_reply": "2026-08-19T12:38:02.988597Z"
    },
    "tags": [
     "remove-input"
    ]
   },
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [

   ]
